artefact.identity_assertions_basis: The identity fields in this specimen were reconciled against The Met public object API at this time; the timestamp does not make them permanently current.

selection.decision_record: Framework direction in COM #76; Claude Code executed the first specimen build.
selection.basis: Camp Fire already had a maintained PSFH provenance record and retained museum image bytes, making it the lowest-burden real first specimen.
selection.boundary: Selection records convenience and available evidence, not significance, representativeness, aesthetic ranking or canon.

purpose_boundary.tested_here: Provenance-record plumbing: owner-source reconciliation, digital byte identity, explicit unknowns, repeatability, machine/human readability and correction.
purpose_boundary.not_tested_here: Whether the Human Record can materially help with contemporaneous human-creation provenance when synthetic and human outputs are genuinely ambiguous. An 1880 work predates that ambiguity and cannot falsify that motivating claim.
purpose_boundary.expansion_authority: This boundary does not authorize specimen 2. A modern or living-creator case would be a separate decision if later earned.

work_status.label: Public Domain
work_status.evidence: The Met object API reported isPublicDomain=true at the owner-source fetch recorded below.
work_status.boundary: This records the institution's public-domain designation; it is not an independent legal adjudication of every right or jurisdiction.

reproduction_use.label: The Met Open Access (CC0)
reproduction_use.evidence: The maintained PSFH source record attributes the museum-published image to The Met Open Access policy and links the museum image-resources policy. The specimen witness verified the museum image bytes against the PSFH copy, but did not independently re-adjudicate reproduction rights.
reproduction_use.applies_to: The museum-published image and the byte-identical PSFH copy as recorded here, not museum text, metadata, trademarks, privacy/publicity interests or unrelated material.
reproduction_use.boundary: Rights in the historical work and permission/status for a particular digital reproduction are different layers.

human_lineage_basis.claim: The Met attributes this physical artwork to Winslow Homer and dates it 1880; this specimen records that attribution and a present-day reconciliation.
human_lineage_basis.not_established: Independent observation or proof of the 1880 creation event.

source_independence.reason: The API record and primary-image endpoint are two endpoints controlled by the same institution; they are not independent witnesses.

source_preservation.museum_api_response: SHA-256 recorded; response bytes are not preserved by this specimen.
source_preservation.museum_primary_image: A byte-identical copy was observed at the PSFH URL at fetch time; the source URL itself is not preserved or made immutable by this record.
source_preservation.warning: A recorded source link or hash does not by itself preserve the source or prove its truth.

epistemic_boundaries.record_event_separation: This record documents observations made on 2026-09-14. It is not the 1880 creation event and does not change that event.

not_established: that the owner's record is correct
that the bytes are the painting rather than the owner's published photograph
that this nineteenth-century specimen demonstrates usefulness against synthetic-era provenance ambiguity

witness.method: fetch owner record and primary image; hash; compare to our record and served copy; write agreement and differences

corrections.change: Added HTTP/pipeline failure handling and narrowed hash mismatch from an asserted cause to an observed byte difference with cause unresolved.
Made source independence, source-preservation, record/event, selection, rights-layer, purpose-test and correction-route boundaries explicit without changing the original observation values or hashes.

correction_route.practice: Propose a dated correction or a fresh recheck; preserve the original observation and hashes unless evidence shows they were recorded incorrectly.
correction_route.access_limit: The current proposal route is GitHub-based and may require a GitHub account. This specimen does not establish an account-free public correction channel.
